summary: CI uses fractal-ci-cache consistently for its local Nix cache, build snapshot archives and performance cache checkpoints.

replay.detail: No graph or event replay change.

compatibility.detail: CI snapshot producers and consumers use the renamed archive directory together, without a legacy path bridge. Complete archives using only the known previous directory layout are clean cache misses; unexpected roots, mixed generations and incomplete archives remain validation errors. Newly minted signing keys use fractal-ci-cache-1; existing keys retain their identity and derived trust. Actions cache key prefixes remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No product downtime; expect one cold CI cache cycle after the directory rename.

manual.detail: No operator step or signing key rotation.

recovery.detail: Revert the coordinated workflow, script and test change.
